title: Research: why desktop first
detail: On a Mac one app can read the focused field and type into any other; phone keyboards cannot see the screen.

title: Landing site live (two designs, merged)
detail: Two directions built side by side, then merged into the one you are reading.

title: Build plan written and independently reviewed — 6 wrong assumptions fixed
detail: A second reviewer checked every claim in the plan; six were wrong and are now corrected.

title: Toolchain: Xcode 27.2 + Swift 6.4

title: P0: self-signed signing keeps the Accessibility grant across rebuilds on macOS 27
detail: A stable local signing identity means you grant Accessibility once, not after every build.

title: P0: Accessibility alone covers both keyboard taps
detail: Watching keys and catching Tab need no extra Input Monitoring permission.

title: P0: TextEdit insert via Accessibility in ~136 ms with clean undo
detail: Accepted text lands in the field as one edit, and a single undo removes it.
